homeSeo.description: ZeFile is the file delivery platform built for African creators. Get paid with Mobile Money, bank transfer, or card before recipients can download. Watermarked previews protect your originals. Send files up to 5 GB free, upload revisions to the same link, and keep up to 97% of every paid transfer. No credit card required.
homeSeo.whatIsDescription: ZeFile is the file delivery platform built for African creators. Upload your work, set a price, and your recipients pay before they can download — with Mobile Money, card, or bank transfer. Your files stay locked until the money lands.
homeSeo.step1: Drop your files and set your price. Add a password or expiry date if you want. Need to revise later? Same link, new version.
homeSeo.step2: Your recipients get a secure link. They can preview watermarked versions of every file before paying.
homeSeo.step3: Once they pay, the originals unlock. You get notified and the money hits your balance.
homeSeo.feature1: Payment protection — get paid before they download your work.
homeSeo.feature2: Watermarked previews — your files stay protected until payment.
homeSeo.feature3: Send files up to 5 GB free. No account needed to receive.
homeSeo.feature4: Works with any file type — photos, videos, audio, design files, documents.
homeSeo.feature5: One link, always current — upload revisions and your client always gets the latest version.
homeSeo.feature6: Mobile Money, bank transfer, or card — your clients pay the way they already pay. No credit card required.
homeSeo.faq1Answer: ZeFile is the file delivery platform built for African creators. Share your work, set a price, and get paid before the download. Done chasing invoices.
homeSeo.faq2Answer: Drop your files, set your price, add recipients. They get a secure link, preview watermarked versions, and pay to unlock the originals. You get notified when the money lands.
homeSeo.faq3Answer: Yes. The Basic plan is $0/month and lets you send up to 5 GB. Starter and Pro plans unlock larger transfers, longer expiry dates, and lower platform fees.
homeSeo.faq4Question: What file types does ZeFile support?
homeSeo.faq4Answer: All of them. Photos, videos, audio, design files, documents, archives — if you can upload it, ZeFile can transfer it.
homeSeo.faq5Question: How do I get paid through ZeFile?
homeSeo.faq5Answer: Your recipients pay when they download. The money goes to your ZeFile balance, and you withdraw via Mobile Money or bank transfer.
homeSeo.faq6Answer: Your files are encrypted and protected with watermarked previews. Recipients see a preview but can't access originals until they pay. Files expire automatically.
homeSeo.faq7Question: Can I update files after sending?
homeSeo.faq7Answer: Yes. Upload a new version to the same link — your recipient always sees the latest files. Version history is preserved so nothing gets lost. Available on Starter and Pro plans.
homeSeo.faq8Question: What payment methods do my clients have?
homeSeo.faq8Answer: Mobile Money (MTN, Orange Money, Wave), bank transfer, USSD, and cards. Your clients pay with the method they already use — no credit card required.

about.subtitle: ZeFile is a secure file delivery platform where creatives share their work, set a price, and get paid before the download.
about.problemP1: You finish the project. You send the files. Then you wait. 72% of freelancers are sitting on unpaid invoices right now —some totaling over $50,000. That's not a hiccup. That's a crisis.
about.problemP2: Meanwhile, the follow-up emails start. "Just checking in." "Any update on payment?" Freelancers spend 102 hours a year chasing late payments. That's almost three full work weeks —not creating, just asking to be paid.
about.problemP3: And here's the thing: 71% of clients have ended relationships over poor delivery experiences. Messy file sharing doesn't just cost you time —it costs you clients. There's no standard workflow for "send files, get paid." So we built one.

about.storyTagline: Born from a real problem. Built for real creatives.
about.storyP1: ZeFile started from a frustration we kept seeing: talented creatives across Africa sending their best work to clients — and waiting weeks to get paid. Photographers, designers, filmmakers. Same story, every time. And 65% of a freelancer's income comes from repeat clients. Lose them to messy delivery, and you lose your business.
about.storyP2: The insight was simple: what if the file transfer itself was the payment moment? What if you could share a link and know — with certainty — that your work wouldn't be downloaded until it was paid for?
about.storyP3: That's what we built. A platform where delivery and payment happen together, in one clean flow. No chasing. No guessing. Just your work, paid for, on your terms.

about.value1Content: Every design decision starts with: does this help the creative get paid? If not, it waits.
about.value2Content: We never decide what happens to your work. You set the price, the expiry, the access. We enforce it.
about.value3Content: No dark patterns. No hidden fees. Pricing is transparent. Cancellation is clean. We'd rather lose a user than trick one.
about.value4Content: We're building infrastructure, not a hype product. Security, reliability, and simplicity over flashy features.

privacy.legalBasisContent:
We process your data based on the following legal grounds under GDPR Article 6:

- Contractual necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)): Account creation, file transfers, payment processing, and service delivery.
- Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): Security measures, fraud prevention, service improvement, and debugging.
- Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): Analytics cookies, marketing communications, and data processing for research purposes. You can withdraw consent at any time.
- Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): Tax and financial record retention, compliance with lawful requests from authorities.
privacy.subProcessorsContent:
ZeFile uses carefully selected third-party service providers to operate. We only share the minimum data necessary.

- Cloud file storage (EU): Secure file storage and retrieval.
- Database hosting (EU): User accounts and transfer metadata.
- Email delivery / Brevo (France): Transactional emails (OTP, notifications).
- Payment processing / Startbutton (West Africa): Payment collection and payouts.
- Analytics / PostHog (EU/US): Usage analytics (with consent only).
- Error monitoring / Sentry (US): Application error tracking.
- CDN / Cloudflare (Global): Content delivery and DDoS protection.

Each provider operates under a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) that ensures GDPR-compliant handling of your data.
privacy.internationalTransfersContent:
ZeFile is operated by Infobulle, registered in Togo. We use service providers located in various regions, including the European Union and the United States. When your data is transferred internationally, we ensure protection through:

- EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs): Applied to transfers involving EU personal data to countries without an EU adequacy decision.
- Adequacy decisions: Where the European Commission has determined the destination country provides adequate data protection.
- Data minimization: We limit cross-border transfers to the minimum data necessary for the service to function.

Your files are stored in EU-region data centers. Error monitoring and analytics data may be processed in the US under SCCs.
privacy.retentionContent:
We retain your data only as long as necessary:

- Uploaded files: Until transfer expiry (default 14 days, maximum 90 days) or manual deletion by the sender.
- Account data: For the lifetime of your active account, plus a 7-day grace period after deletion request.
- Transaction records: 5 years after the transaction (applicable tax and commercial law).
- Activity logs: 12 months.
- Analytics data: Per our analytics provider's retention settings, with consent only.
- OTP codes: Automatically deleted after verification or expiry (10 minutes).

After the retention period, data is permanently and irreversibly deleted.
privacy.complaintContent:
If you believe your data protection rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

For users in the European Union, you may contact the supervisory authority in your country of residence. A list of EU data protection authorities is available at edpb.europa.eu.

You can also contact us directly at hello@zefile.io and we will do our best to resolve your concern.
privacy.automatedDecisionsContent:
ZeFile uses automated processes in limited cases:

- Rate limiting: Automatic temporary restrictions when unusual activity is detected on your account or IP address.
- Account blocking: Automated suspension for repeated violations of our Terms of Service.

These measures are necessary for the security and proper functioning of the Service. You can contact us at hello@zefile.io to contest any automated decision.
privacy.contactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at hello@zefile.io.

security.title: Security <highlight>Policy</highlight>
security.introContent:
We take the security of ZeFile seriously. If you discover a vulnerability, we want to hear about it so we can fix it quickly and keep our users safe.

This policy describes how to report security issues and what to expect from us.
security.scopeContent:
ZeFile is built with security at its core. Here's what we protect:

- File encryption: All files are encrypted during transfer and at rest, ensuring your data stays private from upload to download.
- CDN-powered delivery: Files are served through our content delivery network, adding an extra layer of protection between storage and end users.
- Password-protected transfers: Senders can lock their transfers with a password, so only intended recipients can access the files.
- Early threat detection: We actively monitor for suspicious activity and unusual access patterns to catch potential issues before they become problems.
- Breach prevention: Our infrastructure is designed to limit exposure, with strict access controls and isolated services to reduce the impact of any single point of failure.
security.outOfScopeContent:
The following are out of scope:

- Third-party services operated by our partners
- Social engineering attacks against ZeFile employees or users
- Denial of service (DoS/DDoS) attacks
- Physical attacks against ZeFile infrastructure
- Automated scanning that generates excessive traffic
security.rulesContent:
When researching, please follow these guidelines:

- Do not access, modify, or delete other users' data
- Do not perform destructive testing on production systems
- Do not exploit vulnerabilities beyond a minimal proof of concept
- Report findings promptly and do not disclose them publicly before we've had a chance to fix them
- Use test accounts you create yourself for testing
security.reportingContent:
Send your findings to hello@zefile.io. Please include:

- A clear description of the vulnerability
- Step-by-step instructions to reproduce the issue
- The potential impact of the vulnerability
- Any screenshots or proof-of-concept code

You may encrypt your report using our PGP key (available on request).
security.timelineContent:
Here's what to expect after you submit a report:

- Acknowledgment: within 48 hours
- Initial assessment: within 5 business days
- Resolution target: within 30 days (depending on severity)

We'll keep you updated on our progress and let you know when the issue has been resolved.
security.safeHarborContent:
We will not take legal action against security researchers who:

- Act in good faith and follow this policy
- Avoid privacy violations, data destruction, and service disruption
- Report vulnerabilities to us before disclosing them publicly

We consider security research conducted in accordance with this policy to be authorized and will not pursue legal action for it.
security.contactContent: If you have questions about this policy or need to report a security issue, reach out to hello@zefile.io.
